title: Home guide and safety card: make a space buggy
subject: Art & Design
unit: Spring 1: Printing and a space buggy (Moon Zoom! and Rain & Sunrays)
source: Written for art/y1 lesson 5 (Home practical guide and safety card: the space buggy (portal worksheet); an adult makes every hole)
intro: Lesson 5. Make a buggy that rolls. An adult makes every hole.

practical.aim: Make a buggy that rolls, then test how far it goes.
equipment: Two wooden skewers or thin straws that fit inside the axle straws
A big book to make a ramp
safety: An adult makes every hole in the box and the bottle tops
Skewers have sharp points: an adult cuts the points off first
Keep small bottle tops away from babies
practical.adult: Adult steps: making holes and cutting skewer points.
method: An adult makes two holes on each side of the box, opposite each other.
Push two straws through the box. Keep them straight.
An adult makes a hole in the middle of each bottle top.
Push a skewer through a straw and put a bottle top on each end.
Lean a book on a cushion to make a ramp. Let the buggy roll down. Do it three times.
